text:
No single product I found charges a laptop, phone and watch well, so it comes down to which pairing fits your gear.

## Best single-outlet pick: Baseus Nomos 5-in-1 (140W + Qi2), $149.99
- It has a 140W USB-C PD 3.1 port that can run a 16-inch MacBook Pro, plus a built-in retractable 100W cable and a second USB-C port and a USB-A port.
- The Qi2 magnetic pad charges iPhone 13-16 at 15W, and other Qi2 phones at 5W.
- It has no watch pad, so you'd plug your watch's charger into one of the spare ports.
- Only one port reaches 140W. The retractable cable and the second USB-C top out at 100W, and USB-A at 15W.
- It was **sold out** on Baseus's US store when checked on Oct 21, so confirm stock first.
- [Buy the Baseus Nomos](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-nomos-5-in-1-140w-qi2). This is an affiliate link, so the site earns a commission at no cost to you. [Source](https://dealectric.com/baseus-nomos-5-in-1-140w-qi2)

## If you have an iPhone and Apple Watch: use a 3-in-1 stand for the phone and watch, and your laptop's own charger
These stands have no laptop charging, so the laptop needs its own charger or a hub like the Anker 341 below.
- **Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand** is WIRED's best overall. It charges an iPhone at up to 15W, fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer, and has an AirPods spot. It lists at $109 and was $98 at WIRED, with about $80-90 at Amazon and Best Buy. [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **Anker MagGo 3-in-1** is The StandDeskLab pick for best overall. It lists at $89.99 and is often around $67-70. It folds flat and includes a 40W adapter. [StandDeskLab guide](https://standdesklab.com/accessories/best-desk-charging-station/)
- **ESR Qi2 3-in-1** is the cheapest Qi2 option WIRED found, at about $40 on sale, and it includes a charger and cable. [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

For the laptop side, the **Anker 341 USB-C Hub** (about $40) passes through up to 100W while adding HDMI, an SD slot and extra ports. [StandDeskLab guide](https://standdesklab.com/accessories/best-desk-charging-station/)

I only had the review pages for the Belkin, Anker and ESR products, not direct purchase links. The "shop" and Amazon buttons on those pages lead to current prices.

## Quick guide
- **One device for laptop and phone, with a cable for the watch:** Baseus Nomos, if it's back in stock.
- **iPhone plus Apple Watch plus AirPods, and the laptop charges separately:** Belkin (premium) or Anker MagGo (value).
- **Android phone or non-Apple watch:** Check that your phone is Qi2-certified, since only Qi2 phones get full wireless speed. Your watch will likely need its own proprietary charger anyway. [Office Journal guide](https://www.theofficejournal.com/guide/best-wireless-charging-stations-for-desk)

What laptop, phone and watch do you have? That would settle which one to buy.
